 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 3 16-04-2024

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.

The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 467,
468, 120B of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner has obtained a sim card on the Adhar Card of the informant.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that innocent and has not committed any offence and the petitioner is in custody since 23.12.2023.
5. Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, this application for regular bail is allowed.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.8975 of 2024(3) dt.16-04-2024 7.

Let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Sunil Kumar @ Tulsi @ Sunil Kumar Rai vs The State Of Bihar on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145760914/
1 Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned A.C.J.M.,
Samastipur/ concerned Court below in connection with Samastipur(Town) P.S. Case No. 350 of 2023 subject to condition that:-
7(i).
